Subject: Order form addendum / subcontractor delegation — what we need from Redwood

Ben —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement has reviewed the draft order form and we need to process a delegation amendment so a named subcontractor (CloudOps Integrations LLC) can receive log collection and metrics data. Before procurement will sign we need:

- a short flow-down confirming Redwood will flow the DPA obligations to CloudOps;
- confirmation of subprocessor security posture (SOC 2 type II attestation or equivalent) and one-page summary of encryption/retention controls;
- the amended order form (attached) with the subcontractor name filled in and a suggested signature workflow.

Attaching the OrderForm-ACME-Amendment.docx for your legal to review. Can you loop in whoever owns MSA redlines and confirm an estimated turnaround?

Best,

Subject: RE: Order form addendum / subcontractor delegation — what we need from Redwood

Samantha — Laura from legal here. Thanks for the attachment. High level on our side: we are generally comfortable with flow-downs to named subprocessors, but we need to align on three items before we can represent that in the addendum:

1) Scope of delegated activities — please confirm exact data types CloudOps will access (logs, metrics, request traces, PII/IDs?).
2) Minimum security evidence — we require either a current SOC 2 Type II report OR (i) an ISO/IEC 27001 certificate plus (ii) answers to the attached questionnaire. If you can provide the SOC 2, that will speed things up.
3) Subprocessor liability carve-outs — our standard MSA limits liability to avoid double indemnities; if Acme requires primary indemnity from the subprocessor we will need to escalate.

I've attached specific redline suggestions (see Redwood_MSA_v3_redlines.pdf) and a short addendum template we propose to append to the order form.

Please reply with: (A) confirmation of data types; (B) whether Acme will accept the SOC 2 or needs the questionnaire completed; (C) desired signature method.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_MSA_v3_redlines.pdf (page references to section 6.2 and Exhibit B)

Laura/Ben — thanks, and apologies for the late reply. See quick answers below and attached pack: DPA-evidence-pack.zip.

- Data types: CloudOps will only receive non‑PII telemetry (application logs and aggregated metrics). They will not receive full request payloads or customer PII.
- Evidence: Attached is a redacted SOC 2 bridge letter + encryption overview + subprocessor questionnaire partially completed. The zip contains a one‑page summary for CloudOps.
- Indemnity: Procurement confirms Acme does not need the subprocessor to be a primary indemnitor; flow‑down representations are acceptable.

We can sign via DocuSign. If you send an addendum with the subcontractor name filled in we can countersign within 48 hours of receiving the final doc and evidence.

Samantha Ortiz

procurement@acmecloud.com
